description: Leading platform reliability, cloud automation, and observability practices for production-grade cloud-native environments.

Automated a legacy CI/CD upgrade process, reducing deployment time from 3 hours to 15 minutes per node in a 6-node cluster. Collaborated on a bioinformatics project for a U.S.-based client, managing AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines with Terraform and GitHub Actions. Designed and maintained scalable cloud infrastructure to improve system reliability and developer productivity. Maintained an on-prem Kubernetes cluster for GitLab CI runners. Directed Datadog implementation, enabling real-time monitoring of AWS serverless applications using Firehose and CloudWatch metric streams.

Led migration of Logstash pipelines from Elasticsearch to Splunk and implemented RBAC for secure user access. Migrated Elasticsearch dashboards to Splunk and automated Splunk component creation with Python. Supported a BigPanda to Splunk ITSI migration, moving monitoring integrations and event correlations into Splunk correlation rules. Configured Splunk ITSI to create incidents and escalation policies for PagerDuty and ServiceNow.

Led multiple platform and migration initiatives, including ELK to ECK migration on Kubernetes with Helm, Terraform, and ArgoCD. Migrated a legacy AGS application stack to AWS with Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code. Built an automated, scalable Jenkins-based Gatling load testing workflow for performance teams.

Led Kubernetes upgrade research and production rollouts, managed GCP and AWS deployments, implemented observability with Stackdriver/Prometheus/Grafana, and automated configuration and infrastructure provisioning with Ansible and Terraform.

Supported Kubernetes upgrades, cloud deployment automation, monitoring and alerting, configuration management with Ansible, shell scripting, and Terraform provisioning for AWS and GCP production systems.

Hosted Node.js and .NET applications, automated database backups, secured monitoring with Zabbix, managed AWS infrastructure, containerized apps with Docker, and built CI/CD pipelines and deployment documentation.
Developed and maintained web applications with Node.js and PHP, built Jenkins pipelines, and created web animation and interactive media for clients.

Developed and maintained web applications with Node.js and PHP, built Jenkins pipelines, and created web animation and interactive media for clients. Build Google Ads using Goolge Animate and HTML5 Canvas.
Created web animation and interactive media for clients.
